content.text:
Finding submitted.

**GOVLAW — deviation (preferred target).**

- **Law limb already met:** §18.3 (p0765) selects "the laws of the State of New York, United States," so preferred element 1 is satisfied verbatim and was left untouched.
- **Forum limb fails:** §17.3 (p0744/p0747) sends every non-Expert dispute to exclusive, binding three-arbitrator ICC arbitration, and §17.3(a) (p0748) seats that arbitration in **Osaka, Japan whenever Array demands** it. That is mandatory arbitration outside the accepted-court list — walk-away territory on the forum limb, and it fails the fallback too (fallback also requires courts).
- **Cure (validated, ok:true):** the referral becomes "resolved exclusively as follows," §17.3(a) becomes exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County with a carve-out only for temporary injunctive relief in any other court, and the residual arbitral subsections (b)–(g) are switched off so no "Arbitration Tribunal" mechanic dangles; the heading is conformed to "Litigation." Cross-references to Section 17.3 elsewhere (p0667, p0735) remain valid.
